output.scope_note: The paper is about a Li-Br fuel cell that uses a LATP lithium-ion conducting solid electrolyte, and it quotes one ionic conductivity value for that electrolyte.

records.evidence_quote: solid electrolyte (Li2O-Al2O3SiO2-TiO2-GeO2-P2O5, LATP, 10-4 S cm-1, 25.4-mm square by 150-µm thick, Ohara Inc. Japan)
records.evidence_location: Section 2, Experimental Section (Fuel Cell Design and Fabrication)
records.notes: This is a commercial product value (Ohara LATP plate) given as a material property, not measured in this paper and with no explicit citation in the sentence, so origin is marked literature_cited with some uncertainty. The paper's own EIS measurements (Figs 6-7) give only impedance-based grain and grain-boundary resistances, not converted conductivities, so no records were made for them. Exact LATP stoichiometry and dopants are not stated. Measurement temperature not given.
